_note: App Store captions, one entry per shot, in order. `file` is the raw capture's stem from the demo harness (.e2e-artifacts/appstore/<lang>/). Keep them short and specific: this is the product's voice, not a campaign. `dot` is a status colour (DESIGN §9) — the same language the app uses, carried onto the store page.

en.title: See who needs you
en.sub: A live radar of every agent, colour-coded by state.

en.title: It reaches you first
en.sub: A push the moment an agent needs you, and a Live Activity that keeps the count.

en.title: Answer without walking back
en.sub: The real terminal, in colour — and its question as buttons.

en.title: An HQ triages the rest
en.sub: A supervisor watches the fleet and surfaces only what matters.

en.title: It shows its work
en.sub: Every dispatch, reclaim and note it made, in the order it made them.

en.title: Know where your quota stands
en.sub: Which plan window is tightest, and how long until it resets.

en.title: Switch between your Macs
en.sub: Your MacBook, the studio Mac, even one a teammate shares.

zh.title: 谁在等你，一眼看见
zh.sub: 每个 agent 的实时状态，用颜色分开。

zh.title: 它先来找你
zh.sub: agent 需要你的那一刻推到锁屏，实况活动一直挂着当前状况。

zh.title: 不用走回电脑前
zh.sub: 彩色的真实终端，它问的问题变成按钮。

zh.title: 剩下的交给 HQ
zh.sub: 它替你盯着整支舰队，只把真该你管的事推上来。

zh.title: 它做了什么，都写着
zh.sub: 派活、回收、记账，按发生的顺序摆在那里。

zh.title: 额度还剩多少，心里有数
zh.sub: 哪个窗口最紧，还有多久重置。

zh.title: 在几台 Mac 之间切换
zh.sub: 你的笔记本、工作室那台，还有同事分享给你的。

ipad-en.title: The whole fleet, and the one that needs you
ipad-en.sub: Every agent in the sidebar; the session you open fills the rest.

ipad-en.title: HQ beside your calls
ipad-en.sub: Talk to the supervisor while what is waiting on you stays in view.

ipad-en.title: Every pane, in one view
ipad-en.sub: Sessions as cards, agents and plain shells alike, searchable.

ipad-en.title: What it learned, side by side
ipad-en.sub: The list on the left, the entry on the right, the acts underneath.

ipad-zh.title: 整支舰队，和等你的那一个
ipad-zh.sub: 侧栏是所有 agent，打开的会话占满其余。

ipad-zh.title: HQ 就在该你拍板的事旁边
ipad-zh.sub: 和参谋长说话的同时，等你的事一直在眼前。

ipad-zh.title: 所有 pane，一屏看完
ipad-zh.sub: 会话是卡片，agent 和普通 shell 都在，可搜。

ipad-zh.title: 它学到的，左右并排
ipad-zh.sub: 列表在左，正文在右，能做的事在下面。
